item.description:

item.description:

item.title: [Due in 5 days] From 4 November every default user can create agent blueprints unless 'Users can create agent blueprints' is set to No
item.description:
A default-on permission for every member user to create a new kind of workload identity widens the app-registration surface that consent-phishing and persistence techniques already abuse, and tenants that locked down app registration are not covered by that setting.

Entra · deadline 2026-11-04 · Decide before 4 November: set 'Users can create agent blueprints' to No unless there is a business case, keep Agent ID Developer as the delegated path, and add agent blueprint creation by non-admins to the app-registration detections.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 5 days] Entra stops auto-granting AgentIdentity.CreateAsManager to agent blueprints from 4 November; app-only agents that create their own identities need explicit admin consent or get 403
item.description:
Until now every agent blueprint could mint agent identities without any admin approval and without a visible grant. After the change that authority becomes an auditable, revocable app-role assignment, so the grant itself becomes something to monitor.

Entra · deadline 2026-11-04 · Before 4 November, filter the Entra audit log on ApplicationManagement / Add Service Principal where the initiator is an Application and the target an agent identity; grant AgentIdentity.CreateAsManager explicitly (from 16 October) only to the blueprints that need it, and alert on new grants of it afterwards.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 4 days] Final reminder: the MemberOf rule operator stops processing on 3 November, and dynamic groups built on it freeze in their last state
item.description:
A group that stops recalculating does not fail loudly: it keeps whoever was in it on 3 November. A leaver stays in a group that grants access or a licence, a joiner never arrives in a group a Conditional Access policy targets, and an administrative unit stops following the population it was meant to scope. Nothing alerts, because nothing errors.

Entra · deadline 2026-11-03 · Query dynamic groups and administrative units for membership rules containing memberOf, list which Conditional Access policies, access packages and licence assignments target them, and replace each rule or convert the group to assigned membership before 3 November.

item.title: [New] App management policies gain an audit state in Graph beta: evaluate credential and app restrictions without enforcing them
item.description:
An audit mode is how a tenant can measure what a 'no client secrets' or 'max credential lifetime' policy would break before switching it on, which is the usual reason those policies are never enforced.

Graph · Where app management policies are still off, plan an audit-state rollout of the credential restrictions and review what it reports; the value is beta-only.

item.title: [New] Entra documents Microsoft-initiated revocation of compromised app credentials: tokenRevocations on applications and service principals, issuer 0e0fb671-b107-448b-a273-9d0ded7627a7
item.description:
A workload that suddenly fails with one of these AADSTS codes may be the first sign that Microsoft saw its secret or certificate in an attacker's hands; deleting the revocation to make the error go away re-opens the credential, and tokens already issued can keep working for up to 24 hours on some resources.

Entra · Add the five AADSTS codes and the initiator Azure Active Directory Protection Services on Update application / Update service principal to detections; treat a Microsoft-issued revocation as an incident, rotate the credential and remove anything the attacker added, and never delete the revocation as a fix.

item.title: [New] Entra Agent ID: an agent identity blueprint can now be disabled in all tenants at once, and Microsoft warns agents in other tenants may fail
item.description:

Entra · Add disabling a blueprint in all tenants to the agent incident runbook and watch Agent ID Administrator assignments, since that role can now reach agents in other tenants.
